about: dev2 · The Orchard at Lisle (Lisle shelf). Two points of view, and the writer's notebook (Lisle Notes: People) whose eye colour and kin side the prose contradicts: both belong in Needs You as Which is right?, neither kept as a fact. An Ideas page is left out of Canon and must leave no trace. Months, a holiday, a weekday and a city in passing. Ch 2 holds an open-fact slip (never drinks → drank a full glass). Written by the builder for round 2. needs: the Which is right? questions a run must raise.
